title: Pigmy
summary: PIG'MY, noun [Latin pygmoeus; Gr. the fist.] A dwarf; a person of very small stature; a name applied to a fabled nation said to have been devoured by cranes. PIG'MY, adjective Very small in size; mean

inlines.v: PIG'MY, noun [Latin pygmoeus; Gr. the fist.] A dwarf; a person of very small stature; a name applied to a fabled nation said to have been devoured by cranes. PIG'MY, adjective Very small in size; mean; feeble; inconsiderable.
